name: 6-Passenger 200cc Tuk Tuk Auto Rickshaw
shortDescription: The 6-Passenger 200cc Tuk Tuk Auto Rickshaw is built for commercial passenger transit, taxi fleets, and urban shuttle services. Featuring a powerful 200cc 4-stroke engine, durable rear-wheel shaft drive, 30L high-capacity fuel tank, and rugged leaf spring suspension, it provides reliable daily passenger transport with an economical 4L/100km fuel consumption.

children.text: Designed for commercial passenger transport, urban taxi operations, campus shuttles, and last-mile transit, this heavy-duty 200cc 6-passenger tuk tuk auto rickshaw delivers the perfect balance of passenger capacity, durability, and fuel economy. Built to handle intensive daily driving across bustling city streets and rough rural routes, it provides transport operators with low operating costs and high daily earning potential.
High-Torque 200cc Engine & Enclosed Shaft Drive System

Powered by a fuel-efficient 200cc 4-stroke single-cylinder gasoline engine, this passenger tuk tuk is paired with a 5-speed manual transmission with hand clutch and foot gear shifter. Unlike chain-driven alternatives that suffer from chain stretching, frequent adjustments, and sudden breakage, this model features a heavy-duty rear-wheel shaft drive system mated to a full-floating integrated rear axle. This automotive-style shaft drive ensures smooth power transfer, low maintenance, a top speed of 60 km/h, and strong gradeability of ≥ 15° to tackle steep urban hills.

The passenger area features two rows of thickened, high-density sponge cushioned seats that comfortably accommodate up to 6 adult passengers. An integrated stamped steel roof canopy with insulated PU leather interior lining shields riders from harsh sun and rain, while a single electric windshield wiper and wide-angle side mirrors maintain clear visibility for the driver in heavy downpours.
Heavy-Duty Stamped Steel Chassis & Industrial Leaf Spring Suspension

Constructed on a heavy-duty, one-piece reinforced frame with side-bend bracing and 1.00mm stamped sheet metal body panels, the vehicle offers exceptional torsional rigidity and crash protection. Both the chassis and exterior body undergo full electrophoretic immersion coating and high-temperature baked paint for superior rust and corrosion resistance. Front 430 outer spring hydraulic shock absorbers and a rear 5-piece integrated leaf spring assembly work in tandem with 450-12 heavy-duty mining tires to absorb severe road impacts under full passenger loads.
Low Operating Costs, Long Range & International Container Shipping

With an average fuel consumption of only 4L per 100km and a massive 30-liter fuel tank, drivers can travel more than 750 km between fill-ups. The driver cockpit includes an electronic LCD digital instrument cluster, multi-function handlebar steering, LED headlights, and a multimedia console with USB port, SD card slot, and FM radio. For international fleet buyers and distributors, vehicles ship efficiently in 40HQ containers holding 12 units in SKD (Semi-Knocked Down) or up to 36 units in CKD (Completely Knocked Down) packaging.

faq.question: How many passengers can this 200cc tuk tuk carry?
faq.answer: This tuk tuk is equipped with two rows of high-density cushioned seats engineered to comfortably carry up to 6 adult passengers, making it ideal for urban taxi fleets, campus shuttles, and commercial passenger transport.

faq.question: What type of transmission and drive system does the tuk tuk use?
faq.answer: It features a 5-speed manual transmission with a hand clutch and foot gear shifter, paired with an enclosed rear-wheel shaft drive. The shaft drive replaces traditional chains, eliminating chain slippage, stretch, and frequent maintenance.

faq.question: What is the fuel consumption and driving range on a full tank?
faq.answer: With an average fuel consumption of only 4 liters per 100 km and a generous 30-liter fuel tank, the vehicle provides an operating range of over 750 km on a single tank, significantly reducing daily refueling stops for commercial drivers.

faq.question: How is the tuk tuk packaged for international sea freight?
faq.answer: For international export, vehicles are shipped in standard 40HQ containers. A 40HQ container holds 12 units in Semi-Knocked Down (SKD) form or up to 36 units in Completely Knocked Down (CKD) form to minimize shipping costs per unit.

faq.question: Can the exterior color and branding be customized for taxi fleets?
faq.answer: Yes. While standard production comes in high-visibility yellow, custom paint colors (such as green, blue, red, or white), fleet graphics, and custom upholstery are available for wholesale orders.
